This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. [[Vylla Tendeil]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|brown]] skin and fleshy appearance.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[2 ABY]],<ref name="AoRJtH Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Age of Rebellion - Jabba the Hutt'' 1 to [[2 ABY]].</ref> a member of this species was present at [[Canto Casino and Racetrack]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="AoRJtH">''[[Age of Rebellion - Jabba the Hutt 1|''Age of Rebellion - Jabba the Hutt'' 1]]''</ref> Much later, in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TLJ Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> another nearly identical member of this species, [[Vylla Tendeil]], could be found within the same location.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Flatish-01.jpg|thumb|right|200px|"Flatfish 01" designed by Tim Napper]]
This species made their onscreen debut in the [[2017]] film {{Film|VIII}}, directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> They were originally designed by creature concept designer [[Tim Napper]] and titled "Flatfish 01."<ref name="The Art of">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>
